# Dear ImGui v1.92.9b, vendored

Dear ImGui by Omar Cornut, under the MIT licence in `LICENSE.txt`, for the panel of
LICHOMAT Emu (stage 1b spec 3.3, 6.6). Fetched on 2026-10-31 with the owner's approval,
file by file, from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ocornut/imgui/v1.92.9b/<path>`:
tag `v1.92.9b`, released 2026-07-31, commit `f1cc2ae15e53a861a874c3034aae6798fde194ab`.
The size and the git blob SHA-1 of every file were checked against that commit's tree
(GitHub API `git/trees/v1.92.9b?recursive=1`) before they were copied here. Only these 15
files, unchanged and at their paths in the release, 3,303,558 bytes in all. The ctest id
`R4_imgui_pin` checks every row below and that the folder holds nothing else.
